Class Cell

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.Board.Cell
public class Cell extends Object
The Cell class represents a single cell in a board game. Each cell contains an index, an optional player, and links to the previous and next cells, forming a linked structure.
